info.name: 04-FailureAndRetry
info.description: Resolution axis, self-contained (creates its own fresh Stripe card ride; no DB/Redis access): a Case-2 refund whose Stripe create FAILS (mock override scoped to this ride's payment order via the refund's metadata[order_id]) goes FAILED with a FAILURE refunds attempt linked, the driver-wallet legs it provisionally booked are VOIDED (BPP ledger by entityId), a re-approve without retryRefunds is rejected, and approve+retryRefunds recovers to REFUNDED on a new attempt (refundsTries 2) whose driver legs SETTLE exactly once, with exactly one BAP Refund invoice of -rf2. Asserted through the dashboard refundRequest info/list, the rider refund list + invoice list, and the driver wallet ledgerHistory.
